description: Business validation rules for pacs.009.001.10 (Financial Institution Credit Transfer)

rules.description: Interbank settlement amount must be positive
rules.suggestion: Ensure the interbank settlement amount is greater than zero. Zero or negative amounts are not valid for credit transfers.

rules.description: Interbank settlement amount must respect currency decimal precision
rules.suggestion: Ensure the number of decimal places matches the currency's standard precision. For example, USD/EUR use 2 decimals, JPY uses 0 decimals, BHD uses 3 decimals.

rules.description: Interbank settlement date must not be in the past
rules.suggestion: Settlement date must be today or a future date. Past settlement dates are not valid for new payment instructions.

rules.description: Interbank settlement date must not be more than 90 days in the future
rules.suggestion: Settlement dates more than 90 days in the future may be rejected by some systems. Verify the date is correct.

rules.description: Group header creation timestamp must not be in the future
rules.suggestion: Creation date/time should be the current timestamp or earlier. Future timestamps are not valid.

rules.description: Settlement currency code must be a valid ISO 4217 currency code
rules.suggestion: Ensure the currency code is a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

rules.description: Instructing agent BIC must be valid
rules.suggestion: BIC must be 8 or 11 characters following ISO 9362 format: 4 alpha (institution) + 2 alpha (country) + 2 alphanumeric (location) + optional 3 alphanumeric (branch).

rules.description: Instructed agent BIC must be valid
rules.suggestion: BIC must be 8 or 11 characters following ISO 9362 format.

rules.description: Creditor agent BIC must be valid
rules.suggestion: BIC must be 8 or 11 characters following ISO 9362 format.

rules.description: Intermediary agent BIC must be valid
rules.suggestion: BIC must be 8 or 11 characters following ISO 9362 format.

rules.description: Creditor institution identification must be present
rules.suggestion: Creditor (beneficiary institution) must be identified with a BIC. This is mandatory for financial institution credit transfers.

rules.description: Creditor agent must be present
rules.suggestion: Creditor agent (beneficiary's bank) must be specified for the financial institution transfer.

rules.description: End-to-end identification must be present and non-empty
rules.suggestion: End-to-end identification is mandatory and must contain a value. Use the related customer payment reference (e.g., MT103 field 20) or generate a unique reference.

rules.description: Instruction identification must be present and non-empty
rules.suggestion: Instruction identification is mandatory and must contain a unique value for this interbank transfer.

rules.description: UETR must be a valid UUID when present
rules.suggestion: UETR (Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference) must be a valid UUID format for SWIFT gpi tracking.

rules.description: Charge bearer code must be a valid value
rules.suggestion: Charge bearer must be one of: DEBT (debtor pays all), CRED (creditor pays all), SHAR (shared), SLEV (service level).

rules.description: Settlement method code must be valid when present
rules.suggestion: Settlement method must be one of: INDA (instructed agent), INGA (instructing agent), COVE (cover method), CLRG (clearing system).

rules.description: Group header message ID must be present and non-empty
rules.suggestion: Message ID is mandatory and must be unique. Consider using UUID format or a unique institution-specific identifier.

rules.description: Number of transactions must match actual transaction count
rules.suggestion: The NbOfTxs field must accurately reflect the number of CdtTrfTxInf elements in the message.

rules.description: High-value interbank transfers may require additional controls
rules.suggestion: High-value transfers (>= 1 million in any currency) may require special instructions or regulatory reporting. Verify institutional controls and compliance requirements.
